howItWorks.title: Uko bikora
howItWorks.subtitle: Niba ukodesha imodoka, uhakira umushoferi, cyangwa ushyira imodoka yawe ku murongo — bikorwa mu buryo bworoshye.
howItWorks.renterSearchDesc: Andika aho uri n'amatariki. Reba imodoka n'abashoferi bafite ibiciro n'icyizere.
howItWorks.renterChooseDesc: Gereranya ibiciro, ubwoko, amanota n'aho bari. Soma ibitekerezo by'abandi bakiriya.
howItWorks.renterBookDesc: Ohereza aho gufatira, amatariki, igihe na telefoni. renting.rw yemeza Standard. Extra Premium yemera ako kanya.
howItWorks.renterEnjoyDesc: Fata imodoka cyangwa uhure n'umushoferi. Nyuma y'iyemezwa uhabwa amazina na telefoni kuri SMS na email.
howItWorks.ownerListDesc: Kora urutonde rw'amafoto, igiciro n'igihe ihari. Igaragara nyuma yo kwishyura gahunda y'umucungamutungo.
howItWorks.ownerLiveDesc: Iyandikishe kugirango ugaragare mu ishakisha. Extra Premium itanga ikimenyetso cyemejwe n'ubukode bwako kanya.
howItWorks.ownerConfirmDesc: Ibiro bya renting.rw bihamagara nyirayo ku Standard. Extra Premium ni ako kanya. Nyuma bombi bahabwa amazina na telefoni.
howItWorks.ownerEarnDesc: Ungura ku buryo bwawe. Ingendo zarangiye n'ibitekerezo bizamura icyizere n'uko ugaragara.
howItWorks.trustDesc: Buri mucungamutungo n'umushoferi bafite amanota agaragara. Amanota menshi asobanura kugaragara cyane.

safety.title: Umutekano wawe ni uwa mbere
safety.subtitle: renting.rw ikorerwa ku mafaranga y'ubwiyandikisha, amanota y'icyizere, n'ibiro byemeza booking — buri ngendo irakurikiranwa.
safety.planDesc: Abacungamutungo, abashoferi na tagisi bagaragara nyuma yo kwishyura. Extra Premium ni ikimenyetso cyemejwe, n'ubukode bwako kanya n'telefone ahagaragara.
safety.trustDesc: Buri wese afite amanota agaragara ku ngendo zarangiye n'ibitekerezo. Amanota make agabanya uko ugaragara.
safety.payDesc: Kwishyura binyuze kuri iPay (mobile money n'ikarita). renting.rw ntibika PIN cyangwa numero yuzuye y'ikarita.
safety.contactDesc: Nyuma y'iyemezwa uhabwa amazina na telefoni kuri SMS na email. Numero za tagisi ziguma ku rutonde.
safety.disputeDesc: Ubufasha bukemura amakimbirane hakoreshejwe amateka y'ubukode n'amafoto. Bombi bararinzwe.
safety.supportDesc: Mu byihutirwa mu ngendo, hamagara 0788 781 648. Turahari buri munsi harimo n'impera z'icyumweru.
safety.renterTip1: Reba niba imodoka cyangwa umushoferi bahuye n'urutonde mbere yo gutangira.
safety.renterTip2: Fata amafoto y'ibyangiritse mbere yo gutwara.
safety.renterTip3: Ntusangire PIN z'amafaranga. Ishyura gusa binyuze kuri renting.rw.
safety.renterTip5: Nyuma y'iyemezwa, koresha telefoni washyizweho kandi ubike amakuru yo guhura.
safety.renterTip6: Niba hari ikintu kidakwiriye, hagarara uhame ubufasha.
safety.ownerTip1: Komeza kalendari yawe. Booking za Standard zemezwa n'ibiro bya renting.rw.
safety.ownerTip2: Fata amafoto y'imodoka mbere n'inyuma y'ubukode.
safety.ownerTip4: Imodoka igomba kuba ifite ubwishingizi n'impapuro mbere yo kuyishyira ku murongo.
safety.ownerTip5: Menyesha ubufasha ibikorwa bishobora kuba bibi.
safety.ownerTip6: Hindura igihe ihari kugirango idafatwa kabiri.
safety.emergencyDesc: Hamagara umurongo wacu cyangwa twohereze email, turasubiza vuba.

faq.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faq.subtitle: Ubukode, kwishyura, gushyira ku murongo, n'icyizere kuri renting.rw.
faq.stillDesc: Ubufasha burahari buri munsi. Hamagara cyangwa twohereze email.
faq.bookingA1: Shakisha imodoka cyangwa umushoferi, hitamo amatariki, aho gufatira na telefoni, uhanyuma wohereze. renting.rw yemeza Standard. Extra Premium yemera ako kanya.
faq.bookingA2: Ibisabwa bya Standard bijya ku biro. Duhamagara nyirayo, tuzemeza tukohereza telefoni kuri SMS na email. Extra Premium yemeza ako kanya.
faq.bookingA3: Yego, ku mbonerahamwe. Kuvanaho mu masaha 24 mbere y'urugendo bishobora kugabanya icyizere.
faq.bookingA4: Niba booking yemejwe ivanwaho n'uwatanze serivisi, usubizwa amafaranga n'icyizere cye kigabanuka. Hamagara ubufasha niba ukeneye indi.
faq.payA1: Kwishyura bikorwa igihe hemeza. Dufite mobile money (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money) n'amakarita binyuze kuri iPay.
faq.payA2: Yego. Kwishyura binyuze kuri iPay. renting.rw ntibika PIN cyangwa numero yuzuye y'ikarita.
faq.payA3: Oya. Urutonde rwerekana igiciro cy'umunsi. Ibindi (lisansi, hanze ya Kigali, ingwate) bigaragara mbere yo kubika.
faq.ownerA1: Iyandikishe, rangiza intambwe z'umucungamutungo, hitamo gahunda, uhanyuma ushyire amafoto, igiciro n'igihe ihari.
faq.ownerQ2: Hari amafaranga yo kuyishyira ku murongo?
faq.ownerA2: Yego. Gahunda: Basic 10,000 RWF/ukwezi (imodoka 1), Premium 25,000 (5), Extra Premium 50,000 (ntarengwa, ikimenyetso cyemejwe, ubukode bwako kanya, telefoni ahagaragara). Kode ya promo irashobora kugabanya cyangwa kuvanaho amafaranga.
faq.ownerA3: Amafaranga ajya kuri numero ya mobile money iri ku mwirondoro, muri 24–48 amasaha nyuma y'uko urugendo ruzira.
faq.ownerA4: Fata amafoto. Hamagara ubufasha ufite booking, tuzakemura.
faq.trustA1: Avuye ku ngendo zarangiye, ibitekerezo, n'ibikorwa nko kudahamagara. Agaragara ku mwirondoro, icyatsi / umuhondo / utukura.
faq.trustA2: Yemejwe = Extra Premium — si urupapuro rwihariye rw'irangamuntu. Extra Premium ishobora kubika ako kanya no kwerekana telefoni.
faq.trustA3: Hamagara 0788 781 648 cyangwa twohereze renting.rw@gmail.com. Nyuma y'iyemezwa ufite na telefoni ya nyirayo.
